dataset_name: African Rooftop Photovoltaic Dataset
provider: Shanghai University of Electric Power et al. / iScience
coverage: Global tile mix, verified from the published archive 2026-09-19: Sevilla 28.7%, Los Angeles 13.8%, USAE 8.0%, New York 5.7%, SAFK 5.1%, China 4.8%, Shanghai 4.1%, AFK 4.0%, plus AU/JP/VN/TH. African tiles (AFK+SAFK) 223 of 2,454 = 9.1%. Isipingo Beach (Durban, South Africa) is the only named site.
label_or_geometry: Pixel-wise masks as 512x512 uint8 TIFF. NOT georeferenced: CRS None, identity transform, bounds in pixel space. No polygons, and none derivable.
scale_or_record_count: 2,454 training label tiles verified in train_labels.rar (paper states 2,957 incl. val/test); tiles carry no country metadata beyond an opaque filename prefix.
license_or_access: NO LICENSE FILE in the repository (8 files, none a licence), so default copyright applies and no reuse or redistribution is granted. Archives are git-LFS .rar.
recommended_earthpv_use: Segmentation training chips only, and only if the licence is cleared. CANNOT provide calibration quadrats: roofclf calibration needs a located, bounded, exhaustively mapped area and these tiles have no location at all.
notes: Downgraded from A+ on 2026-09-19 after inspecting the published files rather than the paper. Three earlier claims are unsupported: multi-country African coverage (it is 9.1% African and the plurality is Seville), country metadata accompanying samples (filename prefixes only), and usability for continental calibration (no georeferencing). The masks themselves are genuine and the imagery is real; the value is domain-adaptation training, not labels with a place.
